protocols.name: GMX
protocols.notes: GMX v2 (synthetics) on Arbitrum. ExchangeRouter, GlvRouter and SubaccountRouter are redeployed on upgrades; these are the 2.2.1 deployment the live app uses (the gmx-synthetics main branch still records the older 2.2c set). Express/gasless trading goes through GelatoRelayRouter 0x5503b99308dB6923758F9A22d118207D633c4e87 as EIP-712 signatures a relayer submits, so it is not listed as a transaction target.

protocols.name: Veranta (formerly Avantis)
protocols.notes: Avantis renamed to Veranta on 2026-09-14; v2 (2026-08-12) upgraded implementations behind the same proxies. v2's main write path is EIP-712 intents (domain AvantisTrading) that a relayer submits; direct calldata to the trading proxy remains for most actions. Users approve USDC to TradingStorage 0x8a311D7048c35985aa31C131B9A13e03a5f7422d (a spender, not listed). The LP tranche address is not in any official file found.

contracts.sourceNote: MAINNET_ADDRESSES['Trading'] in the last v1 SDK config (2026-03-30); the v2 SDK fetches addresses from an API and its docs say every proxy address, Trading included, is unchanged. The v2 docs call the intents' verifying contract 'TradingRouter'; that it is this proxy is not confirmed by a file
